question_text:
Immediately on Hom yr Question Paper Booklet by tearing off the paper seal, please check for
(i) The same booklet (A/BIC/D) on each page, (ii) Serial Number of the questions (1-200), (iii) The
number of pages and (iv) Correct Printing. In case of any defect, please report to the invigilator and ask for
replacement of booklet with same code within five minutes from the commencement of the test.
